commands:
for f in skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md skills/implement/phases/phase-3-fix-loop.md skills/review/phases/phase-1-checklist.md skills/review-and-fix/references/loop-exit.md; do
echo "===== $f ====="; grep -niE "marker contract|partial-view|paged|offset.*limit|page it forward" "$f" | head -20
done

cat /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/displaced-paths.txt 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; git -C /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow log --oneline -3; git -C /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow status --short | head -20

H=323aaba2731e2ef4d75657599b55f1939b293564
echo "=== review/SKILL.md: paged recovery + required-copy mirror (VC-1) ==="
git show $H:skills/review/SKILL.md | grep -nE "Paged-read recovery \(before|Required copy\. Rows 1.7 and the paged-read recovery above are mirrored"
echo "=== implement/SKILL.md: required-copy claim + row5 + paged para (VC-1,VC-5) ==="
git show $H:skills/implement/SKILL.md | grep -nE "required copy of .skills/review|duplicated pair still fails row 5|Paged-read recovery \(before …[per-command-truncated]

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
if rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null &&
   git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before &&
   [ -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before ] &&
   [ ! -L .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before ] &&
   git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before; then
  echo "snapshot-ok"
else
  echo "snapshot-failed"
  rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before 2>/dev/null
  printf '%s\n' disabled > .prflow/t …[per-command-truncated]

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
for f in skills/review/SKILL.md skills/implement/SKILL.md skills/create-issue/SKILL.md skills/docs-verify/SKILL.md skills/review-and-fix/SKILL.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-contract.md skills/implement/phases/phase-4-documentation.md skills/review-and-fix/references/fixing.md; do
  b=$(git show 323aaba2731e2ef4d75657599b55f1939b293564:$f | wc -c)
  echo "$b  $f"
done

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/load-prompt-extension.sh requesting-code-review >/tmp/ext.out 2>/tmp/ext.err; echo "EXIT=$?"; echo "---STDOUT---"; cat /tmp/ext.out; echo "---STDERR---"; cat /tmp/ext.err

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
for f in skills/review/SKILL.md skills/implement/SKILL.md skills/create-issue/SKILL.md skills/docs-verify/SKILL.md skills/review-and-fix/SKILL.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-contract.md skills/implement/phases/phase-4-documentation.md skills/review-and-fix/references/fixing.md; do
  n=$(git show "323aaba2731e2ef4d75657599b55f1939b293564:$f" | wc -c)
  echo "$n  $f"
done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
